claim.point: No: a blank email makes the importer reject the whole file, so nothing from that file is imported.
claim.detail: It validates every row before writing, raises an error naming the first invalid line, and writes in a single transaction.

stakes.point: One bad row stops the whole file from importing, so anyone expecting bad rows to be skipped would lose every contact in that file.
stakes.detail: The file has to be cleaned first, or the importer changed to collect errors instead of stopping.
